mentions.name: Joule
mentions.description: An Obsidian plugin for quickly entering caloric and nutritional data, built around a DSL and a runtime for finding and resolving formulae recursively. Core features are done; documentation and convenience features remain.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an Obsidian plugin to quickly enter caloric and nutritional data (https://www.github.com/Krishna-Sivakumar/joule). The core features are done (A DSL and a runtime for finding and resolving formulae recursively), and I need to work on documentation and some convenience features.
mentions.author: ktimespi
